extracted.intended_audience: readers of Nature (scientists, academics, and informed public)
extracted.subtask_description: A news/announcements column reporting scientific society meetings, awards, endowed funds, studentships, and research-fellowship notices; provides the purposes, eligibility/obligation notes, deadlines, and monetary values where stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hanbury medal award purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hanbury gold medal is awarded biennially for high excellence in the prosecution or promotion of original research in the chemistry and natural history of drugs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As recipient Mr. David Hooper (curator of economic and art sections of the Indian Museum at Calcutta) will also receive a sum presented in the name of the late Sir Thomas Hanbury; the medal commemorates original research and promotion in the chemistry and natural history of drugs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leopold Schwach Fund purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: An anonymous donor presented 1000l. to endow a fund to be called 'The Leopold Schwach Fund' for the furtherance of research in the archaeology, art, history, languages, and literature of ancient civilisation, with reference to Biblical study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fund's scope is explicitly tied to research on ancient civilisation topics with reference to Biblical study; the report emphasizes that such private benefactions stimulate scientific studies alongside public funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balfour studentship terms and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Balfour studentship (to be vacant at Michaelmas) is of the net annual value of 300l., or such larger sum as the University may determine; the student need not be a member of the University, and during tenure is required to devote himself to original biological inquiry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications (names and desirable information) should be sent on or before October 1 to the secretary, J. W. Clark, Registry of the University, Cambridge. The studentship funds are intended to support original biological research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Colonial Office / Tropical diseases research fund grant (research studentship in medical entomology)
rubrics_metrics.description: The advisory committee of the Colonial Office for the tropical diseases research fund recommends that a grant of 100l. for two years should be made to assist in establishing a research studentship in medical entomology in Cambridge; Lord Elgin is prepared to approve the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates for the studentship are requested to send their applications to Prof. Nuttall, 3 Cranmer Road, Cambridge, on or before Monday, June 17. (Grant recommendation and application deadline are stated.)

rubrics_metrics.name: University of Illinois Engineering Experiment Station fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: The board of trustees of the University of Illinois has voted that the Engineering Experiment Station be authorised to offer ten research fellowships in the college of engineering of an annual value of 100l.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A pamphlet from the University provides information concerning these fellowships and describes the facilities for experimental work available in the college of engineering (implying selection/award will consider research facilities/fit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statesman's Year-book editorial standard/qualities
rubrics_metrics.description: The 1907 issue of 'The Statesman's Year-book' provides the latest available statistics concerning the States of the world, often up to within a few weeks of publication, and includes re-written sections (e.g., on armies), diagrams, tables, and maps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The reviewer praises the volume for maintaining a 'high standard of accuracy and usefulness'; features contributing to that standard are up-to-date statistics, clearly presented diagrams/tables, and relevant maps (examples: boundary maps and forecasts).
